correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated connected chordal graphs at each order from the singleton, adjoining a vertex with a nonempty clique neighbourhood. This obviously preserves connectedness and rules out new induced cycles of length ≥4. Conversely a simplicial vertex exists by perfect elimination; deleting one preserves chordality, and paths between surviving vertices can bypass it using an edge of its neighbour clique. I deduplicated by exact canonical adjacency encodings over invariant degree blocks, without the source atlas or hash. The counts are 1,1,2,5,15,58,272,1614; there are 7268 attachments before deduplication at order eight. Joint refinement by exact previous-colour and neighbour-multiset tuples, continuing until the colour partition stops splitting, yielded the same counts of classes through seven and 1612 classes at eight, with nontrivial class sizes 2,2. The order-eight exceptions have 13 and 14 edges. Their degree-cell sizes and quotient rows match the finding: (4,2,2) with rows (0,1,1),(2,0,2),(2,2,1), and (4,4) with rows (0,2),(2,3). The two graphs within each pair have 2 versus 4 distinct degree-two open neighbourhoods, confirming the stated nonisomorphism and agreeing with the doubled-matching versus cycle constructions. The source verifier checks equitability and prints the matrices; the independent replay checks their actual numerical values. The result is restricted to competitors that are themselves connected chordal graphs.

evidence: The later all-chordal result enumerates 2119 order-eight objects and 2117 classes with both doubletons connected, so it is strictly broader and contains the result. The same-day cograph result concerns a different class and has first collisions at order twelve. The earlier amenability classification quantifies over all graph competitors.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Global amenability is not equivalent to identification among connected chordal graphs; for example, adjoining a universal vertex to 2K3 and to C6 gives two seven-vertex graphs with the same equitable degree partition, but only the former is chordal. A failure of global amenability can therefore hold below the restricted threshold.

value.rationale: Chordal graphs form a natural graph class and ordinary refinement is a standard structural invariant. This establishes the first loss of separation in that class and describes every minimal exception, not just one computational example. The explicit quotient profiles and pair shapes give minimal benchmarks and separate this relative threshold from global amenability.
